observations: A solid black rounded figure sits low and centered, cropped at the bottom edge, with a small circular knob at its top and two wide lateral lobes flanking a central disc containing small looped and jagged yellow marks.

Yellow zigzag and wavy lines radiate outward from the figure in all directions against a flat deep-orange field, varying from tight zigzags near the top to longer horizontal waves at the sides and lower corners.
A white inner border separates the orange field from a bright yellow outer border, and a small angular yellow signature mark sits in the lower-left corner of the white zone.
reading: The black figure sits in the lower half of the frame, its bulk pressing toward the viewer while the upper field stays open and unbroken. Yellow lines spread outward in every direction — some tight and jagged near the top, others long and rolling at the sides. The small marks inside the central disc suggest a face under some kind of strain, and the overall image feels less settled than suspended.
